temperature.source_catalyst_phase: Iron carbides; microkinetic benchmark on chi-Fe5C2(510)
temperature.applicability: Adopted from the carbide simulation solely as a provisional Fe-FT comparison condition.

gas_standard_pressure.source_location: IUPAC Gold Book S05921, recommended standard pressure
gas_standard_pressure.applicability: Reference for gas activities, separate from the reactor pressure.

gas_activity.source_location: Ideal-gas standard state; Phase 3.2.3.2 gas reference
gas_activity.applicability: Use p_i/p_standard for a declared ideal-gas scenario. Nonideal gas requires a documented fugacity model. Apply the operating-pressure term to the standard chemical potential only once.

adsorbate_activity.value: molecular coverage relative to a declared site-based standard coverage
adsorbate_activity.applicability: Provisional ideal surface convention. A validated nonideal activity model may supersede it.

vacancy_activity.value: vacant sites / total sites in each inventory
vacancy_activity.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
vacancy_activity.applicability: Independent inventory and domain required. Unknown occupancy prevents inference of the vacancy fraction unless independently measured.

multidentate_activity.value: one molecular activity per species on its declared reference and footprint
multidentate_activity.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
multidentate_activity.applicability: A molecule contributes its multiplicity to each occupied inventory. Require an explicit surface activity for cross-inventory rate evaluation. No independent product of coverages or vacancy fractions establishes ensemble availability.

vibration_model.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
vibration_model.applicability: Use a state-specific, structure-bound spectrum and comparable thermal basis, or a reviewed precomputed correction. Record an alternative treatment and its source before use.

gibbs_correction.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
gibbs_correction.applicability: Use the increment excluding ZPE in eV/state and entropy in eV/K/state. Surface p-delta-V is neglected under the fixed-slab approximation.

low_frequency_cutoff.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
low_frequency_cutoff.applicability: No cutoff or floor is prescribed. A modification needs rationale, source, affected modes and scope.

frequency_scale.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
frequency_scale.applicability: No common factor assigned. Record each selected factor, including unity, and its basis.

site_density.unit: mol of sites/m^2 of the specified surface
site_density.source_catalyst_phase: Project surface model; phase and domain must be supplied for a specific system.
site_density.applicability: Absolute normalization requires an independently supported site count and area.

scale.source_catalyst_phase: Metallic Fe(110), CH* + CO* -> CHCO* benchmark only.
scale.applicability: Applies only to this local spectrum; no endpoint calibration is inferred.

zpe_ev.source_location: reviewed_TS.thermal_state; harmonic evaluation at operating_conditions.json project.reference_temperature
zpe_ev.source_catalyst_phase: Metallic Fe(110), CH* + CO* -> CHCO* benchmark only.
zpe_ev.applicability: Local vibrational contribution only; excludes the reviewed imaginary mode. This scenario has no endpoint or reaction free energy.

thermal_enthalpy_ev.applicability: Local vibrational contribution only; excludes the reviewed imaginary mode. This scenario has no endpoint or reaction free energy.
